_readme: The catalogue and the price list.
Three grades, four pack formats. Not every grade ships in every format:
`skus` is the list of combinations actually offered, and it is the list the
price table, the product cards and the quote builder are all built from.
EVERY PRICE IS A PLACEHOLDER while `price_status` is 'placeholder'. Put the
real numbers in, set `effective_date`, set `price_status` to 'live', and
run the build. Nothing else changes.
Price is always per selling unit: per bag for bagged formats, per bulk bag
for totes, per ton for bulk. Per-pallet, per-pound and per-ton figures are
derived at build time, never stored, so they cannot disagree.
